svg.aria-label: Activity diagram of the proposed system, one user. The security engineer captures 11 runs with the study's lab tool, outside the system, while the SIEM archives the events, and uploads the run records and the rule files. The system checks the runs, builds the event keys, compares the runs before and after the change with Myers' difference algorithm, fits the noise model from the control runs, tests each key against it, classifies it, pairs keys that lost a field, links lost keys to rules and ATT&CK techniques, ranks them, recommends, and writes the report. The engineer reads it, gives a copy to the SOC outside the system, and accepts the risk or fixes the rule or the telemetry and tests again.
